mapper.select: SELECT SOURCE_ID AS "sourceId" , SOURCE_NAME AS "sourceName" , OWNER_ID AS "ownerId" , STATUS AS "status" , FIRST_REGISTER_BRANCH AS "firstRegisterBranch" , FIRST_REGISTER_USER AS "firstRegisterUser" , FIRST_REGISTER_DATE AS "firstRegisterDate" , FIRST_REGISTER_TIME AS "firstRegisterTime" , LAST_CHANGE_BRANCH AS "lastChangeBranch" , LAST_CHANGE_USER AS "lastChangeUser" , LAST_CHANGE_DATE AS "lastChangeDate" , LAST_CHANGE_TIME AS "lastChangeTime" FROM DATASOURCE WHERE STATUS = 'Y' AND ( NULLIF(#{search}, '') IS NULL OR SOURCE_ID ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR SOURCE_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' ) ORDER BY FIRST_REGISTER_DATE DESC, FIRST_REGISTER_TIME DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total" FROM DATASOURCE WHERE STATUS = 'Y' AND ( NULLIF(#{search}, '') IS NULL OR SOURCE_ID ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR SOURCE_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' )

SELECT SOURCE_ID AS "sourceId" , SOURCE_NAME AS "sourceName" , OWNER_ID AS "ownerId" , STATUS AS "status" , TABLE_NAME AS "tableName" , FIRST_REGISTER_BRANCH AS "firstRegisterBranch" , FIRST_REGISTER_USER AS "firstRegisterUser" , FIRST_REGISTER_DATE AS "firstRegisterDate" , FIRST_REGISTER_TIME AS "firstRegisterTime" , LAST_CHANGE_BRANCH AS "lastChangeBranch" , LAST_CHANGE_USER AS "lastChangeUser" , LAST_CHANGE_DATE AS "lastChangeDate" , LAST_CHANGE_TIME AS "lastChangeTime" FROM DATASOURCE WHERE SOURCE_ID = #{sourceId}

select d.source_id as "source_id", COALESCE(dh.upload_file_name,d.source_name) as "source_name", dh.upload_id as "upload_id", dh.upload_file_name as "upload_name", c.description as "category_description", d.table_name as "table_name", pg.n_live_tup as "total_record" from datasource d inner join category c on d.category_id = c.category_id inner join pg_stat_user_tables pg on pg.relname = d.table_name inner join datasource_history dh on d.source_id = dh.source_id where d.table_name IS NOT NULL AND d.table_name <> '' AND dh.status = '01' and dh.upload_file_name IS NOT null order by dh.archived_at desc limit 4

select d.source_id as "source_id", COALESCE(dh.upload_file_name,d.source_name) as "title", dh.upload_id as "upload_id", c.description as "category_description", 'xlsx' as "file_extention" from datasource d inner join category c on d.category_id = c.category_id inner join datasource_history dh on d.source_id = dh.source_id where d.table_name IS NOT NULL AND d.table_name <> '' AND dh.status = '01' AND ( d.source_name ilike '%'|| #{search}|| '%' or c.description ilike '%'|| #{search}|| '%' or dh.upload_file_name ilike '%'|| #{search}|| '%' ) order by c.category_id asc, d.sort_order asc

SELECT d.source_id AS "source_id", d.source_name AS "source_name", c.description AS "category_description" FROM datasource d INNER JOIN category c ON d.category_id = c.category_id WHERE d.table_name IS NOT NULL AND d.table_name <> '' AND d.status ='Y' AND ( NULLIF(#{categoryId}::text, '') IS NULL OR c.category_id = NULLIF(#{categoryId}::text, '')::int ) order by d.sort_order ASC;

select d.source_id as "source_id", d.source_name as "title", c.description as "category_description", 'xlsx' as "file_extention" from datasource d inner join category c on d.category_id = c.category_id where d.table_name IS NOT NULL AND d.table_name <> '' AND d.source_id = #{sourceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DATASOURCE_UPLOAD_LOG ( UPLOAD_ID , SOURCE_ID , TOTAL_ROWS , SNAPSHOT_PATH , UPLOAD_MODE , STATUS , STARTED_AT , FIRST_REGISTER_USER , FIRST_REGISTER_DATE , FIRST_REGISTER_TIME , LAST_CHANGE_USER , LAST_CHANGE_DATE , LAST_CHANGE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{uploadId} , #{sourceId} , #{totalRows} , #{snapshotPath} , #{uploadMode} , 'PROCESSING' , NOW() , COALESCE(#{firstRegisterUser},'000000') , COALESCE(#{firstRegisterDate},'20260101') , COALESCE(#{firstRegisterTime},'000000') , COALESCE(#{lastChangeUser},'99999') , COALESCE(#{lastChangeDate},'20260101') , COALESCE(#{lastChangeTime},'000000') )
mapper.update: UPDATE DATASOURCE_UPLOAD_LOG SET STATUS = 'COMPLETED' , COMPLETED_AT = NOW() WHERE UPLOAD_ID = #{uploadId}
mapper.select: SELECT UPLOAD_ID AS "uploadId" , SOURCE_ID AS "sourceId" , TOTAL_ROWS AS "totalRows" , SNAPSHOT_PATH AS "snapshotPath" , UPLOAD_MODE AS "uploadMode" , STATUS AS "status" , STARTED_AT AS "startedAt" , COMPLETED_AT AS "completedAt" FROM DATASOURCE_UPLOAD_LOG WHERE SOURCE_ID = #{sourceId} ORDER BY STARTED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DATASOURCE_HISTORY ( HISTORY_ID, SOURCE_ID, UPLOAD_ID, ROW_DATA, ARCHIVED_AT, FILE_PATH , UPLOAD_FILE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, STATUS ) VALUES ( nextval('datasource_history_history_id_seq'), #{sourceId}, #{uploadId}, COALESCE( NULLIF(#{rawData}, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb ), now(), COALESCE(#{filePath}, ''), COALESCE(#{uploadFileName}, ''), COALESCE(#{description}, ''), '03' );
mapper.select: select d.source_id as "sourceId", dh.upload_id as "upload_id", COALESCE(d.source_name,'') as "title", c.description as "categoryDescription", pg.n_live_tup as "totalRecord" from datasource d inner join category c on d.category_id = c.category_id inner join pg_stat_user_tables pg on pg.relname = d.table_name inner join lateral ( select upload_id from datasource_history where source_id = d.source_id and status ='01' order by archived_at desc -- ⚠️ REPLACE 'created_at' with your actual date/ID column limit 1 ) dh on true where d.table_name IS NOT null AND d.table_name <> '' and c.category_id = #{categoryId} AND ( d.source_name ilike '%'|| #{search}|| '%' or c.description ilike '%'|| #{search}|| '%' ) AND d.status ='Y' ORDER BY d.sort_order ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

select COUNT(*) AS "total" from datasource d inner join category c on d.category_id = c.category_id inner join pg_stat_user_tables pg on pg.relname = d.table_name inner join datasource_history dh on d.source_id = dh.source_id where d.table_name IS NOT null AND d.table_name <> '' AND dh.status = '01' and c.category_id = #{categoryId} AND ( d.source_name ilike '%'|| #{search}|| '%' or c.description ilike '%'|| #{search}|| '%' )

select d.source_id as "sourceId", dh.upload_id as "upload_id", COALESCE(dh.upload_file_name,d.source_name) as "title", c.category_name as "categoryDescription", pg.n_live_tup as "totalRecord", dh.archived_at::date as "lastChangeDate" from datasource d inner join category c on d.category_id = c.category_id inner join pg_stat_user_tables pg on pg.relname = d.table_name inner join datasource_history dh on d.source_id = dh.source_id where d.table_name IS NOT null AND d.table_name <> '' AND dh.status = '01' AND ( NULLIF(#{categoryId}::text, '') IS NULL OR c.category_id = NULLIF(#{categoryId}::text, '')::int ) AND ( d.source_name ilike '%'|| #{search}|| '%' or c.description ilike '%'|| #{search}|| '%' ) ORDER BY dh.archived_at::date DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

select COUNT(*) AS "total" from datasource d inner join category c on d.category_id = c.category_id inner join pg_stat_user_tables pg on pg.relname = d.table_name inner join datasource_history dh on d.source_id = dh.source_id where d.table_name IS NOT null AND d.table_name <> '' AND dh.status = '01' AND ( NULLIF(#{categoryId}::text, '') IS NULL OR c.category_id = NULLIF(#{categoryId}::text, '')::int ) AND ( d.source_name ilike '%'|| #{search}|| '%' or c.description ilike '%'|| #{search}|| '%' )

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "totalRecords" , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE STATUS = '01') AS "totalPublished" , COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE STATUS = '01' AND ARCHIVED_AT >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND ARCHIVED_AT < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month' ) AS "publishedThisMonth" FROM DATASOURCE_HISTORY
